title: Grateful Dead Live at Springfield Civic Center on 1980-09-03
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 2448 Tagged
source: 2x Nakamichi CM300/CP4 shotguns > Nakamichi 550 > Maxell XLII 90's, mics on stand, set up in the arena riser center, end of floor facing the stage.

ai_review.summary: Peerless audience recording captures a sizzling September ’80 show highlighted by a smoking Half‑Step → Franklin’s and tight Let It Grow.
ai_review.review: The tape is an outstanding crowd‑sourced capture that many reviewers call the best of the September ’80 run, with clear, lively sound despite being an audience recording. Musically the band is on fire – the Half‑Step into Franklin’s, Let It Grow, High Time and Sailor > Saint are singled out as exceptional moments.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are overwhelmingly positive about both performance and sound quality; only one anomalous 0‑star rating appears, but the consensus merits a strong four‑plus rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a peerless audience tape with crisp, lively sound and great balance; no specific flaws noted.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The September ’80 run is praised for its high energy and tight pacing; reviewers especially note the killer tempo on the Half‑Step into Franklin’s and an overall strong, consistent show.
